text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... I wonder if this keeps me hidden...

When I went to the trainer's office, Rice Shower
was there, seemingly fussing with her bangs.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I got a bump on my forehead... so I'm trying to hide it with my bangs...
Can you tell...?
choice_data_list: It's okay, you can't see it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If you say so, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If you say so, Big Sister...

Although she accepted the decision, Rice Shower
still seemed worried about her skin condition.
